email_subject: Application - Client Advisor at RIMOWA Antwerp
email_body:
Dear RIMOWA Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the full-time Client Advisor position at your Antwerp store. While my background is in digital marketing and web development, I have long admired RIMOWA's commitment to craftsmanship and storytelling, and I am eager to bring my customer-focused mindset and technical skills to your team.

In my current roles, I manage client websites and ensure seamless user experiences, which has honed my ability to understand customer needs and provide tailored solutions. My fluency in English and native Turkish, combined with my growing Dutch, allows me to connect with international clients. I am passionate about luxury and excited to learn the intricacies of RIMOWA products and repairs.

I am confident that my proactive approach and attention to detail will contribute to first-class client consultations and after-sales service. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can become a valuable travel companion for RIMOWA's clientele.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear RIMOWA Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Client Advisor role at your Antwerp boutique. Although my professional path has been in digital marketing and web development, I have always been drawn to luxury retail and the art of storytelling that RIMOWA embodies. Each suitcase is more than a product—it is a companion that collects memories, and I would be honored to help clients find theirs.

In my current positions, I build and optimize websites for clients, which requires a deep understanding of user experience and customer needs. At Episto, I manage content and SEO for various client sites, ensuring that every interaction is seamless and engaging. This has taught me to listen carefully, anticipate needs, and deliver solutions that exceed expectations—skills that translate directly to luxury client advising. My technical background also means I am comfortable with hands-on tasks, from minor repairs to after-sales support, and I am eager to master RIMOWA's repair processes.

I speak fluent English and native Turkish, and I am actively improving my Dutch. This multilingual ability allows me to connect with Antwerp's international clientele. I am passionate about providing a first-class experience and am excited to learn from RIMOWA's extensive training programs.

While I may be new to luxury retail, I bring a proactive attitude, a keen eye for detail, and a genuine desire to grow within the LVMH Group. I am confident that my blend of customer focus and technical aptitude will make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to RIMOWA's legacy.

Sincerely,
